name: Don't Press The Button 7
desc:
Welcome to Don't Press The Button 7! 🚨🔴
Made by the original creators 💙

This is no ordinary button… every time you press it, something crazy and unexpected happens! Can you survive all 62 wild and fun disasters? 🌪️🔥

⚡ Play with your friends and take on challenging obbies, giant tsunamis, and tons of surprises. Every round is a new adventure! 🎉

🆕 WHAT'S NEW
🪙 Coin shop (with a bonus on your first purchase)
New map: Glasses
New map: Simon Says Keyboard

If you're having fun, don’t forget to like and favorite the game to stay updated on new disasters and exciting updates! 😋🔥
